tasks.label: kill-port-8080
tasks.command: try { $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } } catch {}; exit 0
